archive.headline: One win separates them. One week changes the chase.
Speed Kills meets the PF leader—with one win between them.

trashTalk.headline: All gas. No paper crowns.

lines.text: Speed Kills—163.76 last week. Was that horsepower, or did you use up the whole tank?
